summary: This resolution lets the House immediately consider and vote on concurring in the Senate amendment to the FY2025 budget resolution (H. Con. Res. 14) with one hour of debate and no points of order, and suspends the calendar-day count under the National Emergencies Act for terminating the April 2, 2025 national emergency through September 30, 2025.
